# Dashboard contract routing

Before implementing dashboard behavior, HA integration, ports, or releases,
read [.github/reference/dashboard-contract.md](../reference/dashboard-contract.md)
in full. It is the detailed implementation contract moved out of the
always-loaded root, not optional background reading.

Apply the other matching instruction files and selected layout validation.
Budget routing must not reduce safety, state, visual, provenance, or release
evidence. Instruction contracts are exempt from the large-source-read hook.
